# Sketch.IO

> Sketch.IO is the creator of Sketchpad, a comprehensive digital art and design platform offering drawing tools, graphic design capabilities, and developer APIs for creative applications.

Sketch.IO develops and maintains Sketchpad, a web-based and desktop digital art tool used for drawing, graphic design, and educational purposes. The company also provides SketchAPI for developers integrating sketching and design functionality into their applications.

## Key Topics

- Sketchpad
- SketchAPI
- Digital art tool
